name: Ariwara no Yukihira
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 16); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. 893.

poems.title: If breezes on Inaba’s peak
poems.author: Ariwara no Yukihira
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 16
poems.text:
If breezes on Inaba’s peak
Sigh through the old pine tree,
To whisper in my lonely ears
That thou dost pine for me,—
Swiftly I’ll fly to thee.
